title: Independent code/test review: isiZulu source binding
head: ee4afe0d05acdb4f22ea0de046cb1e63d47fd79a

cases: all 33 snapshot entries exactly equal current canonical fields, including infographicAlt, quiz order/options/correct indices
same-shape changes to title/body/keypoint/quiz/rationale/options/index/alt force whole-lesson English fallback
a full-shaped arbitrary supplied review draft is rejected; exact clone accepted; malformed supplied keyPoints falls back
approved ZU path and ST/TS/VE intro draft paths remain intact
source panel visibility gates tie to ZU/regional draft status

findings.area: Snapshot completeness and strict source matching
findings.evidence: `matchesIsiZuluDraftSource` compares title/body/alt/keypoint count and exact ordered values, quiz count and each ordered question/options/correct index/rationale. The focused test asserts all 33 checked lesson IDs and each snapshot deep-equals the live canonical source object. A single difference returns English fallback for the whole lesson.

findings.area: Supplied review draft cannot override checked copy
findings.evidence: For matching lesson ID + review-draft status, supplied draft must exist, pass complete shape, and deeply match the registered checked-in draft. Otherwise resolver returns canonical English. Exact deep clone passes. Shape validation checks arrays/lengths before iteration, so malformed draft keyPoints/quiz/options are expected to fail closed.

findings.area: No caller-supplied draft leaks through alternate status
findings.evidence: Only the review-draft branch consumes translation.draft. English source mismatch is checked before that branch. Approved published content follows the existing approval gate and was intentionally left unchanged.

Student page gates exact English title/body/keypoint/quiz source display on `sourcePairedDraft`, which includes only current ZU/regional `draft` states. Fallback renders English and its fallback notice; it does not show stale ZU text as a draft. Draft notice explicitly says ZU text lacks fluent-speaker/local-farming approval. Image alt uses localized draft alt only when present; otherwise it falls back to canonical English alt.

Implementation compares the entire body string byte-for-byte, so reordered paragraphs are rejected. The test label says “paragraph order/count” but the changed-body fixture appends an extra paragraph rather than actually reordering same-paragraph content. A pure swap fixture would make that promised case explicit; no resolver defect found.

Current malformed-draft test covers `keyPoints: undefined`; `hasCompleteLessonShape` also checks quiz/options via `Array.isArray` before access, so they fail closed by inspection. Adding malformed `quiz` and nested `options` cases would directly exercise the full stated guard, but no throw path was found for malformed supplied draft arrays.

scopeNotes: Snapshot contains exactly 33 lessons per the focused passing test.
Approved isiZulu and ST/VE/TS path checks passed; no evidence of regional resolver regression.
Review covered source-binding/UI/test path, not semantic correctness of the isiZulu translations.
rootFollowup: Root added actual same-count paragraph reorder and malformed quiz/options fixtures after this review, and replaced union indexing with safe discriminant narrowing. Assertions retained; full ordered gates follow.
